### Consistency in Ministry
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/consistency-in-ministry
Passage: 2 Timothy 1:13-14
Points:
- Paul charged Timothy to persevere in ministry by holding fast to sound instruction.
- Enduring faithful service requires the indwelling Holy Spirit to withstand suffering and opposition.
- Believers are called to preserve biblical truth and pass it on to reliable teachers.
- Ongoing fidelity to God's Word strengthens our assurance of true faith in Jesus Christ.
